audit.whatIsWrong: spikes[1] claims Infinite Duress 'pins him through Mega Adhesive'. Fling is also labelled (Q) in three fields.
audit.why: Mega Adhesive grounds. Grounding shuts off Warwick's dashes, so inside the goo he can cast neither Jaws of the Beast nor Infinite Duress — the page taught the exact opposite. Fling is E (10/9.5/9/8.5/8s); Poison Trail is Q.
audit.corrected: Grounding stated as a hard denial of both his dash abilities, with the instruction to ult from outside the vial; Fling relabelled (E) with its 10s rank-1 cooldown.
sources: Singed kit W 'grounding' flag and text

audit.whatIsWrong: Level 6 was written as a Warwick spike.
audit.why: Insanity Potion is a 100s stat steroid that keeps Singed above the 50% health line that both Eternal Hunger's heal and Blood Hunt's tracking key off, and it applies Grievous Wounds to his Poison Trail — cutting Warwick's healing exactly when he commits.
audit.corrected: Level 6 reassigned to Singed with the 50% threshold named.
sources: Singed kit R text and 'antiHeal' flag

audit.whatIsWrong: The chart gave Singed Level 2 and Level 3 and called Levels 4-6 even, which is backwards on every row.
audit.why: Warwick's window is levels 1-2, before Fling and Mega Adhesive exist. From 4 onward the grounding and Insanity Potion decide it, and Warwick's 48.08% win rate agrees.
audit.corrected: Warwick, Warwick, Skill, Singed, Singed, Singed, Singed — matching the already-audited singed__warwick mirror, paired across both layers.

audit.whatIsWrong: Packet defect: sequencingCues 0 — no numbered 'wait for X' advice.
audit.why: 'When Fling is down' with no number is uncountable.
audit.corrected: Fling's 10s rank-1 cooldown now anchors the step-up rule in the spike and mid text.

edits.before: Level 2 is skill: his poison chip starts to matter but you still control lane tempo.
edits.after: Level 2 favours you: with no Fling yet, your Q lunge chunks him on the wave.

edits.before: Level 3 favours you: W Blood Hunt speed lets you stick to Singed through his Fling-and-run.
edits.after: Level 3 is skill: Blood Hunt speed sticks to him, but Mega Adhesive grounds your Q.

edits.before: Levels 4-5 favour you: Q healing negates Poison Trail and you win every stationary trade.
edits.after: Levels 4-5 favour Singed: Mega Adhesive grounds your lunge and he kites the trade out.

edits.before: Level 6 favours you: R Infinite Duress pins him through Mega Adhesive and his Insanity Potion speed.
edits.after: Level 6 favours Singed: Insanity Potion keeps him over the 50% line Eternal Hunger and Blood Hunt need.

edits.before: W Blood Hunt speed lets you stick to Singed as he Fling-and-runs, and Q healing counters his Poison Trail chip — chase him off the wave whenever his Fling (Q) is down.
edits.after: Blood Hunt speed lets you stick to Singed as he Fling-and-runs, and Jaws of the Beast healing counters his Poison Trail chip — step up whenever Fling (E) is on its 10s cooldown.

edits.before: R Infinite Duress is a hard channel that keeps him in place despite Mega Adhesive (W) and his Insanity Potion (R) speed — burst him before he kites into your minions.
edits.after: Mega Adhesive (W) grounds you: standing in the goo you cannot Q-lunge or R-leap at all. Ult from clean ground — your leap distance scales with Blood Hunt's move speed.

edits.before: Levels 3-6 belong to you. Blood Hunt speed closes the gap every time he tries to Fling-and-kite, Q sustain shrugs off Poison Trail, and R at 6 pins him through his slows before he can Insanity Potion away.
edits.after: Levels 3-6 are a fight over the goo. Blood Hunt speed closes the gap when Fling (E, 10s) is down, but standing in Mega Adhesive grounds you — no Q lunge, no R leap — so bait the vial out, then commit from clean ground.

edits.before: Level 1 you win: your Q ticks beat his early Poison Trail and he has no Fling yet to flip you away. Level 2 is Skill — his poison starts to matter but you still hold tempo.
edits.after: Levels 1-2 are yours: your Q ticks beat his early Poison Trail and he has no Fling until 3 to flip you away. Trade on the wave now — this is the whole window.

edits.before: Use R when his Fling (Q) and Mega Adhesive (W) are down
edits.after: Use R when Fling (E) and Mega Adhesive (W) are down

edits.before: Fling (Q) you into his tower or his jungler
edits.after: Fling (E) you into his tower or his jungler

notes: Two independent defects the packet did not catch: Fling was labelled (Q) in three fields (it is E; Poison Trail is Q), and the level-6 spike had the grounding interaction backwards — Mega Adhesive denies both of Warwick's dashes, so Infinite Duress cannot be cast from inside it. Chart aligned to the already-audited singed__warwick mirror. Insanity Potion's Grievous Wounds on Poison Trail is worth a future line in the itemization/late text; not added here because no field was in the right length band for it.
